data.name: Return: Unknown
data.detailed_description:
Return: Unknown

An abandoned metropolis. Endless possibilities. And you right in the middle of it.

Dive into a survival adventure set in a post-apocalyptic Manhattan, inspired by the freedom of great open-world games and the dark atmosphere of a fallen city. After a global virus wiped out civilization, a living and dangerous world remains, offering you complete freedom.

By day, explore streets, buildings, and towering skyscrapers, gather resources, and build your own path to survival. But when night falls, everything changes.

The infected become more aggressive, move through the shadows, and turn the darkness into a deadly threat. The city that belongs to you during the day becomes their territory at night.

Survive by managing hunger, thirst, exhaustion, cold, and heat, while even keeping an eye on your body weight, which directly affects gameplay. Every decision matters.

Use vehicles such as cars, boats, airplanes, helicopters, and mini-submarines to travel across land, water, and air. Build anywhere: on the ground, on rooftops, or high above on skyscrapers, or reinforce existing structures to create a secure base.

Whether alone or with others, you decide how to survive. Fight, trade, explore, or create your own safe haven in a ruthless world.

Dynamic weather, changing seasons, and unexpected events such as power outages constantly reshape the world and force you to adapt.

Play alone or with others, survive in co-op, or compete on servers with up to 128 players.

Features:

  • Open post-apocalyptic world set in Manhattan

  • Inspired by freedom, atmosphere, and survival pressure

  • First-person and third-person perspectives

  • Deep survival systems (hunger, thirst, temperature & body weight)

  • Vehicles: cars, boats, airplanes, helicopters, and mini-submarines

  • Free building or reinforcing structures on the ground, rooftops, and skyscrapers

  • Crafting, farming, hunting, and resource systems

  • PvE & PvP (infected and other players)

  • Dynamic weather, seasons & day-night cycle

  • Special events such as power outages and airdrops

  • Trading system

  • Singleplayer & Multiplayer (co-op and servers with up to 128 players)

Info:

Players can host their own servers or play in peer-to-peer mode. Whether you want to create your own world or join others, Return: Unknown gives you full control over your multiplayer experience.

data.short_description: Return: Unknown is a survival adventure game set in post-apocalyptic Manhattan. Once a thriving metropolis, it has been abandoned by civilization following the outbreak of a global virus, offering both challenges and countless opportunities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64Bit
  • Processor: 8 Cores or better (Example Ryzen 7 o. Intel Core i7)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB Vram or better (NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 5700 XT)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 90 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 - 64Bit
  • Processor: 8 Cores or better (Example Ryzen 7 o. Intel Core i7)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 12GB Vram or better (NVIDIA RTX 4070 or AMD RX 6900 XT)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 90 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
